title: Fractional Hardy--Maz'ya inequality on a half-space
summary: The main purpose of this article is to provide a fractional counterpart of the well-known Maz'ya inequality on the half-space, that is $$ \int_{\mathbb{R}^{d}_{+}}\int_{\mathbb{R}^{d}_{+}}\frac{|u(x)-u(y)|^p}{|x-y|^{d+sp}}dy\,dx\ge\mathcal{D}_{d,s,p}\int_{\mathbb{R}^{d}_{+}}\frac{|u(x)|^p}{x_d^{sp}}dx+C_{d,s,p,τ}\int_{\mathbb{R}^{d}_{+}}\frac{|u(x)|^p}{x_{d}^{sp-τ}\left(x_{d-1}^2+x_d^2\right)^{τ/2}}dx, $$ where $\mathcal{D}_{d,s,p}$ stands for the sharp constant in the fractional Hardy inequality on a half-space $\mathbb{R}^{d}_{+}$.
